head: O2 now blocks scam calls with AI for all UK customers
dek: O2 has moved from flagging suspected scam calls to blocking them before the first ring, for all customers on compatible devices, at no extra cost. It expects to stop more than 3 million calls a week.
details: The AI-based blocking follows a trial earlier this autumn and is switched on automatically across O2's network.
means: If you're on O2, fewer scam calls should reach your phone, with nothing to set up.
todo: Nothing to switch on. Keep reporting scam numbers by text to 7726, as O2 asks.
thumb_words: O2 BLOCKS SCAM CALLS WITH AI
